speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Schizophrenia with comorbid Major Depressive Disorder.

The timeline indicates psychosis (hallucinations) preceded the mood episode, and the specific content of the voices ("worthless") suggests delusions of persecution or nihilism rather than mood-congruent auditory hallucinations typical of primary depression. Given the 7-month duration of psychosis and 4 months of major depressive symptoms, a primary psychotic disorder with secondary depression is the leading diagnosis. I recommend an MRI of the brain to rule out organic causes and a toxicology screen to definitively exclude substance-induced psychosis, despite the patient's denial.
